schema.name: etf_master
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE etf_master (
  ticker           TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name             TEXT NOT NULL,
  issuer           TEXT,
  asset_class      TEXT,
  index_name       TEXT,
  cik              TEXT,
  series_id        TEXT,
  has_nport        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  net_assets       REAL,
  coverage_status  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'directory',
  last_filing_date TEXT,
  notes            TEXT,
  created_at       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  updated_at       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
, coverage_depth INTEGER DEFAULT NULL)

schema.name: fund_snapshot_monthly
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE fund_snapshot_monthly (
  series_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
  report_month     TEXT NOT NULL,  -- 'YYYY-MM' e.g. '2026-01'
  ticker           TEXT,
  net_assets       REAL,
  total_assets     REAL,
  total_liabilities REAL,
  holdings_count   INTEGER,
  monthly_return_1 REAL,           -- most recent month return %
  monthly_return_2 REAL,
  monthly_return_3 REAL,
  derivatives_flag INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  securities_lending_flag INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  filing_date      TEXT,
  period_end       TEXT,
  created_at       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  PRIMARY KEY (series_id, report_month)
)

schema.name: fund_holdings_monthly
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE fund_holdings_monthly (
  id               INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  series_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
  report_month     TEXT NOT NULL,  -- 'YYYY-MM'
  ticker           TEXT,
  security_name    TEXT,
  cusip            TEXT,
  isin             TEXT,
  security_ticker  TEXT,           -- ticker of the held security (if equity)
  position_value   REAL,
  weight_pct       REAL,
  shares           REAL,
  asset_cat        TEXT,           -- EC, DBT, ABS, MBS, STIV, OPT, FUT, FWD, OTHER
  issuer_country   TEXT,
  is_restricted    INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  created_at       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
, snapshot_status TEXT DEFAULT 'complete')

schema.name: idx_holdings_series_month
schema.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_holdings_series_month
  ON fund_holdings_monthly(series_id, report_month)

schema.name: idx_holdings_security
schema.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_holdings_security
  ON fund_holdings_monthly(security_ticker, report_month)

schema.name: idx_holdings_cusip
schema.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_holdings_cusip
  ON fund_holdings_monthly(cusip, report_month)

schema.name: idx_snapshot_series
schema.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_snapshot_series
  ON fund_snapshot_monthly(series_id, report_month)

schema.name: idx_holdings_status_series_month
schema.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_holdings_status_series_month
ON fund_holdings_monthly(snapshot_status, series_id, report_month)

schema.name: idx_fhm_isin
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_fhm_isin ON fund_holdings_monthly (isin) WHERE isin IS NOT NULL

schema.name: holdings_pipeline_state
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE holdings_pipeline_state (
  key              TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  value            TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
)
